programme.title: Nánu Pa Ta?
programme.desc: From local news and cultural celebrations to volunteer opportunities and support for local businesses, “Nanu Pa Ta?” provides a valuable platform for residents to stay informed and engaged in their neighborhood. With its charismatic host Jenna Lumbang-Parungao and entertaining segments, it offers both information and entertainment, making it a favorite among viewers of all ages. Tune in to “Nanu Pa Ta?” to stay connected and be a part of the vibrant Kapampangan community.

programme.title: Balen At Balita
programme.desc: “Balen at Balita,” stands as the preeminent source of current, reliable news in the Central Luzon region. Upholding its unwavering dedication to public service, the program delivers objective and fact-based news coverage, earning the trust of its viewers. The CLTV36 News team consistently strives to be the most esteemed and dependable news source in Central Luzon, providing timely and credible information that keeps the community well-informed and connected to the latest developments in the region.

programme.title: CLTV36 Teleskwela
programme.desc: Provides students in Pampanga, from Grade 1 to Grade 12, a safe place to continue their learning through innovative teaching modules using television as a medium.
